title: IVG  Air 4-in-1 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The IVG Air 4 in 1 is perfect for vapers seeking a diverse range of fruity flavours. This innovative device combines the reusability of a rechargeable system with the outstanding flavours that IVG’s are famous for, all contained in convenient prefilled pods. Equipped with a powerful 1100mAh battery, the IVG Air 4 in 1 ensures prolonged use and consistent performance, making it ideal for all-day vaping. The device features a USB Type-C charging port for rapid recharging, ensuring you’re never left without your vape for long. Available in a diverse variety of multi-flavour editions, each kit includes four prefilled IVG Air Pro pods containing 2ml of 20mg (2%) nic salt e-liquid. These pods offer a premium mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience that’s gentle on the throat while relieving nicotine cravings fast. Flavours: The IVG Air 4 in 1 has a selection of 10 editions that come in a variety of flavours: Red Edition - Strawberry Watermelon, Strawberry Ice, Watermelon Ice and Fizzy Cherry Blue Edition - Blue Sour Raspberry, Blue Raspberry Ice, Blue Raspberry Cherry and Strawberry Watermelon Pink Edition - Fizzy Cherry, Lemon Lime, Watermelon Ice and Pineapple Ice Black Edition - Kiwi Pineapple, Fizzy Cherry, Starwberry Watermelon and fizzy Lemon Yellow Edition - Blue Razz Cherry, Pineapple Passionfruit, Lemon Cherry Ice and lemon Cherry Passionfruit Green Edition - Fizzy Cola, Fizzy lemon, Watermelon lemon and Mango Pineapple Purple Edition - Grape Ice, Blue Razz Cherry, Fizzy Cherry and Blue Razz Plum Silver Edition - Kiwi Pineapple, Watermelon Lemon, Lemon Lime and Blue Raspberry Ice Sky Edition - Fizzy Cherry, Blue Sour Raspberry, Blue Raspberry Ice and Strawberry Raspberry Ice Gold Edition - Pineapple Ice, Fizzy Cherry, Tropical Fruits and Kiwi Pineapple How to use: The IVG Air 4 in 1 vaping system is designed for ease of use, providing a ready-to-vape experience right out of the box. Follow these five simple steps to start enjoying your vape: 1. Remove all packaging from the device, including the bottom sticker and the mouthpiece rubber. 2. Press on the mouthpiece and turn it anti-clockwise to open. 3. Insert all four pods with the arrows facing down. 4. Reattach the mouthpiece by pressing and turning it clockwise to close. 5. To select your desired flavour, rotate the base and line up the arrow with the shown flavour. Shop IVG Air Refill Pods
